benches.engine: deckaudit.py（写出真实 .pptx 再读回审计）
deckbuild.py 端到端：修订记录、CJK 溢出、字体、确定性、母版链、嵌入
extra_rules.py 四个 section，每个缺陷带假阳性守卫

note: One planted defect per scenario; each clean baseline must report no high or medium finding, so blanket flagging cannot pass. A missing typeface, a font without glyphs, a non-reproducible build, a broken master chain and a declared embedding that the package does not carry cannot be expressed in a spec, so bench_deck2 injects/patches them on a real written package. Reports are rewritten next to the benches on every run (scripts/report_deck*.json, scripts/report_extra.json); the shipped copies are from the verification run.
